ml.text: It is likely Glacies, Umbra, Cruor and Fumus are extremely old, as they date back to the Zarosian Empire in the Second Age and fought in the God Wars in the Third Age, alongside Nex. According to Cruor, all of them have spent thousands of years in previous wars. It remains unknown how they maintain this unnatural lifespan for humans.

place.title: Zarosian Empire
place.summary: The empire was ruled by the god Zaros himself at the capital city of Senntisten which was located east of where Varrock stands today. Archaeological discoveries by the end of the Fifth Age spurred interest in Zarosian history and culture. The subsequent return of Zaros to Gielinor in the Sixth Age followed by research efforts forwarded by Dr Nabanik have led to the rediscovery of many long forgotten cultural elements.

Like Volatile TzekHaar-Hur, it will start charging volcanic energy over time, which will cause it to explode, dealing 6,000 damage to the player and killing it, as well as failing the challenge. It however has a damage reduction that prevents it from being injured by attacks that deal 3,000 or less damage, so the use of special attacks, enhanced abilities, or damage-increasing abilities such as Sunshine are recommended to be able to kill it in time.

get_inside.text: Karamja

Shilo Village has two entrances: the gate to the east by using the right-click "Enter-village" option with Mosol Rei, and a tunnel shortcut under the northern wall (requiring completion of the Elite Karamja achievements and level 74 Agility, which is boostable).

get_inside.text: Two items, the Slayer cape (by teleporting to Duradel/Lapalok) and the Karamja gloves 3, teleport directly to inside the village.
Karamja lodestone

This method involves the most walking, but it requires no items nor quests completed to reach the gate. Head a short distance south-east from the Karamja lodestone until you reach the musician, then head a long way south, passing west of Tai Bwo Wannai. Keep going parallel to Karamja's west coast until you reach a small bay, then go south-southeast, around Cairn Isle, and then south past the bridge. Go a short distance southeast until you see another musician, then go east along Shilo Village's south wall until you reach the eastern gate.
Shilo Village cart system

Players who have completed the Shilo Village quest may use the Shilo Village cart system, which is run by Hajedy in Brimhaven. For a price of 10 coins, he will take the player to Vigroy in Shilo Village. The reverse trip is also possible. This makes it easy for the player to access Shilo Village if they first use the Catherby lodestone, then travel by ship to Brimhaven or teleport to the Karamja lodestone and then walk north until they get to the fruit tree patch and then east. Alternatively, if the player has planted a Spirit tree in the patch in Brimhaven, they could just walk north-west of it to reach the cart.
Karamja gloves

Karamja gloves 3 provide unlimited free teleports to the underground part of the Shilo Village mine. This can also be used to reach Brimhaven by taking Vigroy's cart from the south western corner of the village.
Slayer cape
The Slayer Cape can be used to teleport directly to Duradel (or Lapalok after While Guthix Sleeps), in the north eastern section of the village.
Fairy rings

The fairy ring CKR, south of Tai Bwo Wannai, can be used to reach Shilo Village, but you will have to walk around the south and enter by the east gate if you don't have the agility level and achievements to use the northern tunnel shortcut.

The fairy ring CJS within the Kharazi Jungle (requires partial completion of both A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen and Legends' Quest as well as 5 bittercap mushrooms in order to repair the ring if not already done). After teleporting, run west and exit the jungle north to reach Shilo Village.
Gnome glider

Take a gnome glider to the Gandius location (requires completion of The Grand Tree quest) and run west past the overgrown idol and then south until you reach the waterfall with stepping stones which you must cross. After successfully crossing the stones, run directly west to the broken cart and cross to enter the village.

get_inside.text: The temple is located in the eastern island of Karamja, at a waterfall located roughly to the east of Shilo Village. From Tai Bwo Wannai, travel east and cross a wooden log and then follow the river bank south until you reach a mound of earth near the waterfall.

If you have access to the gnome glider network, you can travel to Al Kharid, take the glider to the Gnome Stronghold, and then take the glider to "gandius" (Karamja). From there, walk a little north-west to reach the mound of earth.

"Search" the mound of earth and click the option to use your spade to dig it up, the one on your tool belt should work. Light your torch and use it on the fissure to illuminate it – you will lose the light source. Add a rope to the fissure, securing it to the lip. Search the fissure again to climb down into the temple below – 32 Agility is a requirement. After a short period of time, the earth forms back over the entrance. Your light source and rope will be permanently in place.

Prior to handing the wampum belt to Trufitus during Shilo Village, both the search and examine options will result in the message "It just looks like some bumpy ground", and the temple cannot be entered.
